notes.title: Chibi Escape: Demo Now Available on Steam! 🎮🎮
notes.content:
The Chibi Escape demo is now live on Steam! In this captivating adventure, players are challenged to solve puzzles and guide lovable characters to safety from various tricky situations. Each level presents new and exciting challenges, ensuring an engaging experience.

By playing the demo, you’re not only enjoying a great game but also supporting Ukrainian developers who are showcasing their talents at the Ukrainian Games Festival 2024. Your feedback and encouragement are invaluable as the team continues to work on the full version of the game.

Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey and be a part of the growing Chibi Escape community. Play now, enjoy the magic, and share your thoughts with the developers! 🚀

📢  Remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912090/Chibi_Escape/]wishlist [/url]and follow Chibi Escape on Steam!
